games.name: TLK Prison
games.desc:
SHUTDOWN == UPDATE
Game rule: No exploits.

Join the civilian team to prevent unwanted combat and having reset disabled.
Vote kick exploiters or server disruptors.
 
Tool info:
Taser - Ragdolls the target.
Handcuff - Disable tool usage for the target.
Rope - Ties the target who will remain immobile - they must be cuffed from behind.
Grab - Grab the target, only if they are tied or downed.  

Controls:
LeftShift to sprint
LeftControl to shiftlock
Q to throw while grabbing (Throw button)
E to dash
Q to stomp (near ragdolled/downed targets)
T to throw knife
Backspace to drop

Console:
Y to stomp
B to shiftlock
R3 to throw knife
L2 to dash
L3 to sprint
R2 to use certain tools (cuffs & special actions)

SECURE. CONTAIN. PROTECT.
─────────────────────────────────
Welcome to SCI - Pathos III, one of the most well-known SCP Foundations within the Roblox SCP Genre.
Pathos III is the designation of an installation of facilities created by the SCP Foundation located deep within the Pacific Ocean. The exact depth of the facility remains classified. 

By creating cutting-edge technology and pioneering new containment procedures for the Foundation abroad, this installation contains some of the most dangerous anomalies. It is considered one of the most well-kept strongholds in human history and provides the Foundation with a unique testbed for interactions with anomalous entities and artifacts.
